crossRefs.note: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”
He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”
Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you…
So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than…
My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.
One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor preferring one another;
doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”
translations.bsb: Peter said to Him, “Even if all fall away on account of You, I never will.”
translations.kjv: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
translations.asv: But Peter answered and said unto him, If all shall be offended in thee, I will never be offended.
